finding.title: Evaluation accounting for spatial dependence
finding.body: The manuscript describes spatial blocks and nested evaluation that separates model selection from final assessment. Spatial blocks alone do not guarantee spatial independence.

original.title: Study setting: 50 km evaluation blocks
original.body: The original study used this setting to reduce evaluation bias caused by spatial dependence.

new.title: New data: decide from spatial properties
new.body: Determine evaluation blocks after examining spatial dependence and the scope of application. Do not use 50 km as a default.

setting.summary: Paper: 50 km · New data: decide from spatial characteristics

attach-code.title: Add existing code
attach-code.body: Link file information for your analysis code to the draft.

draft-code.title: Plan code writing from the paper

dialog.title: Illustrative file contents
dialog.description: Examples of skill instructions and a workflow request. They have not been installed or generated as files.

files.illustration: The Workflow name and description reflect the edited draft.
files.skillInstructions: Inspect data coverage and positive records, then design evaluation accounting for spatial dependence. Record model-comparison criteria and limits of application. Do not transfer the paper's 50 km setting directly to new data.
files.workflowRequest: A request to prepare the selected Workflow draft, from data inspection through interpretation.
files.workflowInputs: Required inputs: research data, positive records, evaluation design and comparison criteria. Actual skill IDs and executable code connections are not included.

trial.requestNote: Only the request contents have been previewed. No data analysis, code execution or result assessment has taken place.
